order: fixed repository, original nonmerge commit order, then sorted source path; no model output used
package: original sole-parent tree; only permitted target source is overlaid with exact reference AFTER file
qualified_only_if: before exit 1 with original failures, no errors/skips/outer timeout, after exit 0 with no failures/errors/skips, identical nonempty original case identities, real sandbox attestations; then separate license, context, exact reference codec and old-source/test dedup gates
sandbox: same bwrap unshare-all, clearenv, cap-drop ALL, no host home/credentials, read-only dependencies/package/tests; only per-child /out and temporary tmpfs writable
test_scope: Every whole original test file changed by the repair commit; if none exists, every original test*.py in its tests tree. No individual failing case filtered.
tests: unaltered original AFTER tests and their original helpers/fixtures, mounted read-only
